verdict.rationale: Polar publishes versioned OpenAPI specs and machine-readable docs (llms.txt/.md pages) plus a sandbox environment for testing API calls with test cards, which supports API exploration, but there is no evidence of an actual interactive API reference UI (e.g., a Swagger/Redoc-style console) with embedded runnable examples directly in the docs. Missing for 10: an in-docs interactive 'try it' console, embedded runnable code examples per endpoint, and independent confirmation the OpenAPI spec renders as an explorable reference.
